selection_basis: independent EML metadata only; no response-bearing CSV was requested

counts.reason: EML schema has species and NumInd but no site or event key; cannot define the frozen site-year endpoint without post-response alias discovery

fielddata.reason: EML schema has EventDate, Point_Name, species identity, Event_ID and Bird_Count, but does not expose the standardized event exclusion/no-observation fields available in R1

R1.reason: EML independently documents a joined analysis-ready schema with PointCode, EventID, EventYear, EventDate, ScientificName, BirdCount, ExcludeEvent, NoObservations, Incidental and ExcludeObservation

authoritative_response.immutable_identity: NPS Reference 2317363 + DownloadFile 757402 + frozen EML SHA256
authoritative_response.live_transport_preflight: HEAD only; no GET and no Range request

join_semantics.site_join_rule: exact trimmed string equality; any alternative alias or normalization discovered after response is forbidden
join_semantics.event_join_rule: both must parse as finite integer-valued numbers and compare as integers; no alternative event-key discovery after response
join_semantics.year_rule: response EventYear must parse as an integer in 2007-2019 and equal the year of the matched nonresponse visit EventDate

binary_flag_semantics.missing_ExcludeEvent: conservatively exclude that event from the eligible event universe
binary_flag_semantics.missing_Incidental: conservatively exclude that observation from positive evidence
binary_flag_semantics.missing_ExcludeObservation: conservatively exclude that observation from positive evidence
binary_flag_semantics.missing_NoObservations: allowed because target absence is defined from the eligible visit universe rather than requiring an explicit zero row

site_year_algebra.eligible_event: a forest-visits Event_ID in years 2007-2019 with Point_Name in the qualified point registry, matched to at least one R1 row whose ExcludeEvent is exactly 0; events with no R1 match or only missing/1 ExcludeEvent are not eligible
site_year_algebra.eligible_site_year: Point_Name x EventDate-year with at least one eligible event
site_year_algebra.target_positive_event: eligible event containing at least one R1 row with ScientificName exactly 'Melanerpes carolinus', ExcludeObservation=0 and Incidental=0; BirdCount magnitude is not required for binary presence
site_year_algebra.target_positive_site_year: eligible site-year with at least one target-positive event
site_year_algebra.target_negative_site_year: eligible site-year with zero target-positive events
site_year_algebra.no_eligible_event: excluded from modeling, never coded as negative
site_year_algebra.duplicate_target_rows: collapse to one binary positive at event and site-year levels
site_year_algebra.BirdCount_missing: does not negate an otherwise exact species detection because EML documents BirdCount may be permanently missing or not collected

integrity_stops_after_single_response_fe: required exact column missing or renamed
response PointCode cannot exact-join to the frozen point registry for analyzable rows
EventID cannot be reconciled to the frozen visits registry under the frozen integer rule
binary exclusion flag contains an unexpected nonmissing token
frozen 30/30 estimability minima fail in any model-selection or outer partition
